claims.text: MiniMax announced H3 at the end of July as a multimodal generative model intended to unify tasks across image, video, and audio generation and cross-modal context understanding.
MiniMax describes H3 as supporting up to 2K video output with native stereo sound and multimodal references spanning image, audio, and video.
At announcement time MiniMax said it planned to open the model weights in the coming days, so the launch itself must not be written as an already-completed open-weight release.

limitations.text: Generation quality and capability examples are vendor demonstrations; the announcement explicitly described weight publication as planned rather than complete at that moment.

claims.text: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio lists international availability of Qwen-Audio 3.0 TTS models on July 14, 2026.
The same lifecycle page lists a Wan 2.7 reference-to-video snapshot for the international region on July 1, 2026.
Alibaba describes the Qwen-Audio 3.0 Flash variant as targeting low-latency real-time interaction and the Plus variant as targeting higher-quality professional scenarios.

limitations.text: Availability is region-specific and the performance/quality descriptions are vendor claims from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.
